What we restore

Every kind of property damage, handled

From a burst pipe at 2 a.m. to hurricane aftermath, one crew covers the full job — cleanup, drying, removal and restoration. Pricing is confirmed by phone for your specific situation.

Water Damage Restoration

Extraction, structural drying and dehumidifying after floods, burst pipes and appliance failures — the faster water comes out, the less damage spreads.

Fire Damage Restoration

Debris removal, soot cleanup and restoration of fire-affected rooms and structures.

Mold Removal

Contained, safe removal of mold growth — and the moisture source behind it gets addressed too.

Smoke Damage

Soot and odor cleanup for walls, ceilings, furniture and belongings after a fire — even in rooms the flames never reached.

Storm & Hurricane Response

Emergency response after hurricanes and severe storms, including temporary roof tarping to keep the water out while repairs are planned.

AC & Plumbing Leaks

Leak-driven water damage from air-conditioning units and plumbing — cleanup, drying and restoration of the affected areas.

Temporary Roof Tarp

A secured tarp over a damaged roof buys you dry time — stopping active leaks until permanent repairs can be made.

Quick answers

        

          How much does restoration cost?
          
Every job is different — the extent of the damage decides it. Call (305) 469-6441 and pricing for your situation is confirmed by phone before work begins.

        

        

          Can you bill my insurance directly?
          
Yes — insurance direct-billing is available. Mention it on the call (or select it in the request builder above) and the team will walk you through what your claim needs.

        

        

          A storm just damaged my roof. What do I do first?
          
Stay clear of any downed lines or unsafe areas, then call. A temporary roof tarp can be secured over the damage to stop water getting in while permanent repairs are arranged.

        

        

          Do you handle both homes and businesses?
          
Yes — All Pro serves residential and commercial properties across Miami, FL, around the clock.
